ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the middle of Figure 2 is a map of Japan, and on the two sides are statistical charts of temperature and precipitation. The climate statistical chart corresponding to Takada shows that the precipitation bars in the winter months are relatively high; the climate statistical chart corresponding to Tokyo shows that winter precipitation is relatively low, and precipitation is more concentrated in the warmer season. Then reason: Takada is located on the side of the Sea of Japan, and Tokyo is located on the side of the Pacific Ocean. In winter, Japan is affected by the winter monsoon from the Asian continent. When the winter monsoon crosses the Sea of Japan, it obtains water vapor, and after reaching the coast of the Sea of Japan it forms more precipitation or snowfall, so Takada has more winter precipitation than Tokyo.

method.method_draft: 先从图中两个气候统计图比较降水季节分配：确认高田冬季柱状降水明显高于东京。再结合日本冬季受来自亚洲大陆的冬季风控制，冬季风越过日本海后带来水汽，在高田一侧形成较多降水，因此答“受冬季风影响”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图2中部是日本地图，两侧是气温、降水统计图。与高田对应的气候统计图显示冬季月份降水柱较高；与东京对应的气候统计图显示冬季降水较少，降水更多集中在较暖季节。再推理：高田位于日本海一侧，东京位于太平洋一侧。日本冬季受来自亚洲大陆的冬季风影响，冬季风越过日本海时获得水汽，到达日本海沿岸后形成较多降水或降雪，所以高田冬季降水比东京多。
method.model_answer: 受冬季风影响；冬季风越过日本海带来水汽，使高田冬季降水较多。
method.answer_match_reason: 预测答案明确指出高田冬季降水较多是受冬季风影响，并补充了冬季风越过日本海带来水汽的具体机制，与标准答案一致且更详细。
